title: The FF normalization batch one (census 944)

banner.title: The FF normalization batch one - the letters a-g, the first 71 of 185 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission, the FF arc opener
banner.provenance: The FF normalization - the per-book schema pass opens for the Fiend Folio (the R879 normalizer doctrine, the R1009-R1014 MM1 arc, R1016 the OA book close, R1017-R1020 the MM2 arc closed): the first 71 sparse FF defs rewritten to the canonical FIELD_ORDER emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; all 497 patches are anchored sentinel inserts - the fields already in canonical order, no reorders, no comma sites, no pin repairs (the FF book carries no fragment grids - the promotion headers are census-style, the R1018/R1020 mirror class is empty here); the loader reads the sentinels under the R879 uniform coercer doctrine already live on the 787 normalized MM1, MM2 and OA defs

audit_comment: THE FF NORMALIZATION OPENER - the letters a-g, the first 71 of 185 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; every patch an anchored sentinel insert.
include_after: #include "rules/mm/mm2_letters_s_to_z.h"  // R1020: the MM2 normalization batch four

consts.name: fq1Round
consts.comment: the FF normalization batch one - the letters a-g, 71 of 185, the FF arc opener

consts.name: fq1DefsNormalized
consts.comment: the FF defs rewritten to full-field canonical form this batch - the letters a-g

consts.name: fq1FfTotal
consts.comment: the FF def census - unchanged by the batch

consts.name: fq1FfNormalizedAfter
consts.comment: the FF defs carrying the full-field emission after this batch

consts.name: fq1FfRemaining
consts.comment: the FF defs still sparse after this batch - the letters h-z

consts.name: fq1SchemaKeys
consts.comment: the canonical FIELD_ORDER length - every FF def emitted with all 57 keys

consts.name: fq1InsSites
consts.comment: the anchored insert sites - 1917 inserted lines, all sentinel fields

consts.name: fq1CommaSites
consts.comment: the trailing-comma whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, every text field already carried the Lua-optional comma

consts.name: fq1ReorderDefs
consts.comment: the defs needing whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, the fields already in canonical FIELD_ORDER

consts.name: fq1PatchEntries
consts.comment: the file patches this round - 497 monster windows, all anchored sentinel inserts

bools.name: fq1NormalizerCensusLive
bools.comment: the landed normalize_registry.py reads its full 1338-def census - the registry floor live

bools.name: fq1FullFieldEmission
bools.comment: every rewritten def carries all 57 keys - string sentinel n/a, integer sentinel -1, saveAsBonus the loader zero default

bools.name: fq1InsertOnly
bools.comment: zero whole-line rewrites, zero deletes - every patch an anchored insert, the pre-existing field bytes ride untouched

bools.name: fq1NoClassedDefs
bools.comment: no classed defs in the letters a-g - zero saveAs keys, the R155 contract untouched
